title: Reported Speech 5 – Alles zusammen
description: Wiederholung: Zeiten, Pronomen, Zeitangaben, Fragen, Befehle, Fehler finden

items.answer: Leo said that he had visited his grandma the day before.
She told me that they would arrive the following week.
Our teacher asked us if we had done our homework.
Dad told us not to play football there.
They said that they were going to move to Leeds the following month.

items.task: Be the teacher! Korrigiere den Satz.
items.prompt: Anna said me that she was busy.
answers: Anna told me (that) she was busy.
items.hint: tell braucht die Person direkt danach: told me. Mit said geht nur said (that) … oder said to me …

items.task: Be the teacher! Korrigiere den Satz.
items.prompt: The boys said that they will play football the next day.
answers: The boys said (that) they would play football the next day.
The boys said (that) they would play football the following day.
items.hint: Nach said im Past wird will zu would.
